acquisition method: A fully automated 12-steps MudPIT run was performed during which each full MS scan (from 300 to 1,700 m/z range) was followed by 20 MS/MS events using data-dependent acquisition.
cleavage agent: protein mixtures were trichloroacetic acid precipitated, urea denaturated, reduced, alkylated and digested with endoproteinase Lys-C followed by modified trypsin digestion.
collision energy: Fragments were produced using CID with 35% normalized collision energy and detected by the Orbitrap at 7,500 resolution.
enrichment method: we carried out immunoprecipitations from HeLa cell cytoplasmic and nuclear extracts.
fractionation method: Crosslinked peptides were fractionated using SCX-StageTips following published protocols for linear peptides
fragmentation method: Fragments were produced using CID with 35% normalized collision energy
instrument: Peptides were analysed on an LTQ Orbitrap Velos mass spectrometer coupled with an UltiMate 3000 Rapid Seperation LC system
ionization type: LTQ Velos linear ion trap mass spectrometer equipped with a nano-LC electrospray ionization source
labeling: Relative protein abundance for each protein in a given sample was estimated by normalized spectral abundance factor.
